description:
"What kind of person do you think I am?”
"…A stranger."

Lee Su-Ha, who has been locked up in an unidentified facility for a long time, is dragged out by strangers one day. He meets a man and starts living with him, before discovering he himself is an Omega who was sold to an Alpha.

"Alright, be like that. Just know that what kind of person I become from now on is up to you.”

He is concerned about the fact he has no heat cycle and is unable to conceive due to his abnormal physical condition, but the man doesn't seem to care that Lee Su-Ha is not fulfilling his role as an Omega.

"You hate it when I treat you kindly. That's why I'm doing my best to accomodate you."

What the man's true feelings are, the hatred he feels towards him, the feelings of déjà vu... Lee Su-Ha becomes more and more confused as the number of inexplicable things keeps increasing...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
